name: C025 ROOSTERS Theorem Governance for Delta/Gamma Adversarial Search
purpose: Reuse the strongest benign governance, memory, independence and uncertainty mechanics from the ROOSTERS lineage to accelerate theorem-candidate discovery and falsification without allowing learned components to alter exact proof scope, exact receipts, or theorem verdicts.

current_theorem_lane.current_attack: Find an exact reachable state with ordinary Delta(F)>0 and full-v2 Gamma(F)>0.
current_theorem_lane.Gamma: min_{(a,b) in G_v2(F)} min_{x in Roots(F)}(U(exists x M_{a,b}(F))-N^2)

imported_abstractions: quarantine and cooldown for unreliable routes
move relevant episodes toward the worker handling a related fingerprint
uncertain learned traces are quarantined rather than deleted
JGPT safe decisions include requesting a second route or deferring to exact

imported_mechanics: support is counted across distinct prior fingerprint epochs rather than repeated observations inside one epoch
TOPA suspicion combines distribution drift, cluster youth, prior exact prediction error and fingerprint distance
surprise may widen search immediately while narrowing requires prior independent support
the current episode cannot increase the authority that selected it
adaptive weights stay bounded and are pulled toward preregistered priors
resource exhaustion returns UNKNOWN rather than a fabricated exhaustive negative

may: partition candidate sets across JUXTAPOSE clones
must_not: delete a member of the frozen proof-required grammar
convert timeout or budget exhaustion into NO_V2_RESCUE
promote a candidate lemma to FORMAL
use the current fresh exact outcome to justify the authority that selected that outcome

ordinary_Delta_positive_claim.requirement: Every live original root pivot is exact-probed under the frozen cap semantics, or a theorem-safe early-abort certificate proves that pivot exceeds cap.

v2_Gamma_positive_claim.requirement: Every candidate in the frozen polynomial v2 grammar is covered and every eligible original root pivot after each admissible macro is exact-probed or theorem-safely certified above cap.

requirements: frozen original algorithm reaches the exact target fingerprint at the relevant call-site
full frozen v2 Gamma(F)>0 is exact-complete
no heuristic or fast-screen result is used as theorem authority

fingerprint_independence.rule: Repeated mutations, replays or observations inside the same structural fingerprint epoch do not count as independent support for narrowing search or increasing heuristic authority.
fingerprint_independence.family_locality: Competence and trust are local to structural/fingerprint families; authority does not transfer globally by default.

trust_and_quarantine.failure_action: Reduce routing authority or quarantine the heuristic/template; never delete exact historical evidence.
trust_and_quarantine.recovery: Slow, context-local, and requires multiple independent exact-backed epochs; one success cannot restore full authority.
trust_and_quarantine.negative_prediction_asymmetry: A heuristic claim that a candidate is useless may lower priority but can never suppress proof-required coverage.

memory_policy.M2R: Retrieve and migrate related exact episodes toward workers handling structurally similar candidates.

trigger: candidate result that would refute L1
second_route_policy.note: Independent second routes increase audit confidence but do not replace a symbolic universal proof.

COLD.use_when: new/OOD structural family, weak independent support, recent surprise, or high suspicion
COLD.behavior: wide JUXTAPOSE coverage; learned systems may order but not prune

WARM.use_when: context-local support exists but is insufficient for aggressive ordering
WARM.behavior: ranked/batched exact coverage with widening on surprise

HOT.use_when: well-supported prior fingerprint epochs and good exact-backed calibration
HOT.behavior: aggressive ordering for finding a positive rescue quickly; if the scientific question is a universal negative such as Gamma(F)>0, HOT still must eventually cover the complete frozen candidate set

search_controller.asymmetry: Surprise may widen immediately; narrowing is earned slowly.

theorem_candidate_ecology.cycle_detection: Repeated derivation/rewrite loops in lemma space are detected locally and deprioritized without changing their exact historical status.
theorem_candidate_ecology.bounded_propagation: Derived lemma trees and cross-agent relation propagation have explicit depth/budget limits; exhaustion returns UNKNOWN, not truth.

Delta_Gamma_adversarial_objective.search_goal: Produce an exact-reachable state that defeats both ordinary elimination and every frozen v2 rescue.
optimization: maximize the minimum ordinary overflow margin
maximize the minimum post-v2 rescue overflow margin
reduce attainable tautology/collision relief across the entire v2 grammar
increase the frozen v2 first-rescue index; ideal candidate has no rescue
Delta_Gamma_adversarial_objective.screening: Fast or family-specialized screens may reject easy-to-rescue chassis and rank hard candidates, but have zero theorem authority.
Delta_Gamma_adversarial_objective.promotion_to_theorem_candidate: Only exact frozen reachability plus complete original-semantics v2 replay may promote a SCREEN_NONE candidate to an L1 counterexample candidate.
